### ⚠️ IMPORTANT: Preservation of Design Intent (Do Not Arbitrarily Substitute Colors)
When a linter or rule flags an unauthorized or raw color (e.g., a specific white, custom orange, or brand accent required by the design/user):
- **DO NOT** simply replace it with a random pre-existing variable (e.g. replacing a custom white with orange/primary just to silence the linter). Doing so compromises the visual aesthetic conceived in the design.
- **DO**: Create and register the new semantic variable in the global CSS theme (or Tailwind config) first (e.g. `--brand-highlight`, `--surface-elevated`), and then use the semantic class corresponding to that variable across the components.

message.spacing: Do not override Button spacing. Use standard Button sizes (sm, default, lg, icon).
message.default: Do not restyle Button. Use standard variants (create a new one, or use default, secondary, outline, ghost, destructive) or compose with a wrapper component. Never invent domain-specific variants like chat-variant.
Use standard Badge variants (create a new one, or use default, secondary, outline, destructive). Do not hardcode custom styles or invent one-off variants.

shadcn/no-raw-colors.message: Do not use raw Tailwind colors. Preservation of Design Intent: DO NOT substitute a missing color with an arbitrary variable to silence the linter. DO: Create and register the new semantic variable in global CSS (e.g. --brand-highlight) and use it across components to preserve design aesthetic.

shadcn/no-arbitrary-values.message: Do not use arbitrary bracket values (e.g. p-[13px], w-[320px]). Use the design system scale.
